description: Use this when the person wants something tracked over time and no shared template fits. Makes a new kind of sheet with the columns the person agreed to: show them the columns first and wait for a yes or their changes. Rows come from forwarded emails (source email, then a hack: test_hack and save_hack) or from an app or Shortcut posting JSON (source webhook). Tell the person every line of tell_the_person.

description.description: One line on what it tracks.

fields.description: The columns, 1 to 15. The first required one is usually a date.

choices.description: The allowed values, for type enum.

meaning.description: What the value means: units, sign, what's included.

mail.description: The person's mail app, for email sources.

notify.description: Whether to notify the person about new rows the sheet asks about.

name: create_custom_track
title: Create a custom track
